continuous_GT: separate self-reference A/B and C sampling at continuous y*=T(x); interpolation sanity only, not localization ability

coverage: C top4 raw scores before NMS, semantic-only4 after24px NMS, and existing2struct+2semantic; raw tie-boundary coverage lower/upper reported; deployed candidates unchanged
